name: euphoria
source:
When he came to, he found himself in a white room that he didn't recognize...

Takatou Keisuke was locked in a white, closed room with six other women: his childhood friend Hokari Kanae, class rep. Andou Miyako, junior Makiba Rika, English teacher Aoi Natsuki, same-year student Byakuya Rinne, and classmate Manaka Nemu. All of them were confused by this abnormal situation when a "mysterious voice" suddenly announced to them:

"The game will now begin."

Keisuke must become an "Unlocker" and select one of the women as a "Keyhole," then perform a specified act with her to "open the lock" so that they can all escape from the white rooms.

One girl went into a frenzy over those acts' irrational, extreme, and immoral contents, lashing out at the "mysterious voice." The lights suddenly went out, and all the girls shrieked out of fear. When the lights came back on, the first thing Keisuke and the others saw was the rebellious girl from earlier, restrained to a torture device.

"Withdrawal from the game will result in death." - the mysterious voice announced.

The electric current began to run through the torture device the moment after the voice stopped speaking. The girl's eyes rolled up into the back of her head as she went incontinent, defecating and urinating herself. The women cried and shouted, clearly disturbed by what was happening before them.

On the other hand, Keisuke found himself inexplicably aroused by what was happening to the said girl. For he kept a dark secret. A taste for sexual assault and destructive urges against women... it was his horrible desire that he wanted to keep to himself.

Unfortunately for Keisuke, his classmate Nemu saw right through him this time. And being the cunning woman she is, she won't skip this opportunity to start using this newfound information so that she can blackmail him and ultimately make him submit to her.

"This is a kiss to seal our deal." - she said when she suddenly sealed his lips.

Despite being surprised by her unexpected actions, Keisuke resolved to violate the other women as a means of escape from the white rooms to protect his childhood friend Kanae. Will Keisuke be able to escape unharmed and return to his everyday life? Or will his very desires consume him...? It remains to be seen.

translation:
醒来时，他发觉自己置身于一间陌生的白色房间……

高远惠辅与六名女性——青梅竹马帆刈叶、班长安藤都子、学妹蒔羽梨香、英语教师葵菜月、同年级生白夜凛音，以及同班同学真中合欢——一同被囚禁在封闭的白色房间里。所有人都对这异常状况感到困惑，忽然，一个「神秘声音」向他们宣布：

「游戏现在开始。」

惠辅必须成为一名「解锁者」，选出一名女性作为「钥匙孔」，再与她完成指定行为来「打开锁」，这样众人才能逃出白色房间。

其中一名女孩因这些行为荒谬、极端且不道德的内容而失控，对「神秘声音」怒吼。灯光突然熄灭，所有女孩都因恐惧尖叫。当灯光重新亮起时，惠辅等人首先看到的是先前反抗的女孩被束缚在一台拷问器具上。

「退出游戏将导致死亡。」——「神秘声音」宣布。

话音刚落，电流便开始流过拷问器具。女孩翻起白眼，大小便失禁，失禁地排出粪便和尿液。女性们哭喊起来，显然被眼前的情景深深惊扰。

另一方面，惠辅竟莫名因眼前发生的一切而兴奋。他藏着一个黑暗秘密：对女性抱有性侵犯的嗜好和破坏冲动……那是他一直想独自隐藏的可怕欲望。

不幸的是，这次他的同班同学合欢一眼看穿了他。她是个狡猾的女人，绝不会错过这个新发现的机会。她借此勒索惠辅，最终逼迫他屈从于自己。

「这是用来确认我们交易的吻。」她突然吻上他的唇，说道。

尽管对她意外的行为感到惊讶，惠辅仍决定，为了保护青梅竹马叶，要以侵犯其他女性作为逃离白色房间的手段。惠辅能否毫发无伤地逃脱，回归平凡的日常生活？还是会被自己的欲望吞噬……一切尚未可知。
